Name: Craftable Qi Seasoning
Author: Wizadroid
Description: I couldn't find anyone who's added a recipe for Qi Seasoning so I did it myself. It currently doesn't require reaching Ginger Island, just level 10 farming. However the requirement of radioactive ore does mean you'll need to reach the walnut room. Enjoy.
